CustomField.description: End of the calibration period. Eight years for both AC and DC - MessEV Anlage 7 Tabelle 1 Nr. 6.7 covers them in a single entry, which is exactly why they are identical - then § 34 Abs. 2 MessEV pushes the end to 31 December of the year in which the period mathematically ends, because the period is at least one year long.
